title: B-2 Access Control Maintenance
description_text: This is a solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested. This is a sole-source requirement to Honeywell-Vertiv Corporation, with the exclusion of full and open competition authorized by 12.102(a). The Air Force Sustainment Center Operational Division (AFSC/PZIOA) is located at Tinker Air Force Base Oklahoma. The solicitation number is FA810126Q0005. It is issued as a Request for Quote (RFQ). This acquisition is issued as an Other Than Full and Open Competition. This acquisition is Sole Source to Honeywell-Vindicator under (NAICS) 561621. Responsible sources may submit a proposal, or quotation, which shall be considered by the agency. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 561621. Base Year: 1 April 2026  31 March 2027 Option year 1: 1 April 2027  31 March 2028 A Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Purchase order will be issued for this requirement. The Contractor shall: Propose all cost associated with all services and labor at Tinker AFB, OK. Quotations are due: 30 March 2026 NLT 12:00 PM CST. Contact the following individuals for information regarding this solicitation: Contract Specialist: Cindy Hunter e-mail: cindy.hunter.1@us.af.mil Contract Specialist: Anneli Walsh e-mail: anneli.walsh@us.af.mil Contracting Officer: Michael Shand e-mail: Michael.Shand@us.af.mil  Emailed proposals only  Please include company address, point of contact name, phone, and email, company cage code, and SAM Unique Entity ID.  Please quote for each line item  Please review all attachments  Please send all quotes in the form of a PDF. Do not send excel spreadsheets.
